posts.title: What’s new for Fedora Atomic Desktops in Fedora 45
posts.description: Fedora 45 is now available ! 🎉 So let’s see what this new release for the Fedora Atomic Desktops variants includes for Silverblue, Kinoite, Sway Atomic, Budgie Atomic and COSMIC Atomic. Note: You can also read this post on the Fedora Magazine.

posts.title: Sealed Fedora Atomic Desktop bootable container images
posts.description: I’m happy to announce that we have sealed bootable container images ready for testing for the Fedora Atomic Desktops! Note: You can also read this post on the Fedora Magazine.
